SELECT
    segment,
    count() AS customer_count,
    avg(total_spend) AS avg_spend,
    avg(distinct_products) AS avg_product_variety
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
        uniqExact(ProductKey) AS distinct_products,
        max(DateKey) AS last_purchase,
        multiIf(
            dateDiff('day', max(DateKey), toDate('2026-04-23')) <= 90, 'Active',
            dateDiff('day', max(DateKey), toDate('2026-04-23')) <= 180, 'At Risk',
            'Churned'
        ) AS segment
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment;
